text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The day of the Shinzan Kinen has<n>finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The lineup is full of formidable<n>opponents, but Taiki
Shuttle doesn't<n>shrink back one bit.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In order to become Umamusume of<n>the Year, she
sets off toward the<n>racecourse with power in her
step!
